current.text: Charlotte's projected starters are Coby White, Kon Knueppel, Brandon Miller, Naz Reid and Moussa Diabaté. Schröder is projected as a bench guard with Allen, Steinbach, O'Neale and Grant Williams.
The experts agree he will not start in Charlotte. He would only take Coby White's starting spot if White gets hurt.
Coby White is out with a calf injury and will probably miss the start of the season. Kon Knueppel is also hurt, so Charlotte is short on healthy guards.
Do not draft him inside the top 200. His Yahoo ADP of 128 is too high. One expert would take him only with the last pick of a draft.
Charlotte has a deep roster, and playmaking is expected to be shared among several players instead of one lead creator.
With a March 28 end, Charlotte plays 4-3-4 games in the fantasy playoff weeks. It has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum. Its two-game week starts March 1, which is week 18, before our playoffs.

His ESPN projection (11.2 points, 4.9 assists in 24.7 minutes) has no category that stands out, and his 40.5% FG on 9 shots per game last season is a small drag. In the first weeks, check whether Coby White's calf injury moves him into the starting lineup or a bigger bench role. If it does, he is a short-term waiver pickup for assists, not a long-term hold.
